newsitem.title: USA: Cumberland unit in alliance with USF&G.
newsitem.headline: Cumberland unit in alliance with USF&G.

text.p: Cumberland Technologies Inc said Tuesday that its subsidiary, Cumberland Casualty & Surety Co, has formed a strategic alliance with USF&G Corp's Surety Group to produce small contractor and commercial surety business in the U.S.

The alliance, said the company, will provide USF&G's agents with the ability to access Cumberland's surety bond software program "BondPro," a bond issuance and accounting system specifically developed for surety producers.
The alliance will also provide existing USF&G agents with a competitive market for those risks they now place with specialty niche companies with competitive terms and conditions.
Cumberland Technologies's insurance unit provides contract, landfill, notary, various commercial surety bonds, and registered investment advisers' liability insurance.
